criteria.id: a newly stored password uses Argon2id with salt and algorithm parameters
bcrypt and PBKDF2 hashes remain accepted fallbacks
password rotation replaces the stored hash and the previous password no longer verifies
a disabled credential cannot log in
passwords and raw secrets are not present in thrown error messages
a structured channel message creates a collaboration task with requester, assignee, objective, inputs, skills, tools, checks, due milestone or date, priority, blockers, and context tags
accept, decline, question, answer, transfer, block, unblock, complete, and cancel update task status and write an auditable event
a transfer names sending role, receiving role, reason, transferred context, expected next action, required evidence, and unresolved questions
agent runtime refuses to start from a collaboration task that lacks required fields, skills, tools, or checks
developer board and WorkItem views show open collaboration tasks and customers cannot create or transfer them
